name: POLE Racing Raincoat for Motorcycle Cycling Outdoor Waterproof Rainsuit & Rain-Pants Set Motocross Breathable With Free Storage Bag
description:
Product details of POLE Racing Raincoat for Motorcycle Cycling Outdoor Waterproof Rainsuit & Rain-Pants Set Motocross Breathable With Free Storage Bag
100% Waterproof & Breathable – Made from Nanotechnology PVC-coated fabric to wick away moisture instantly.
Premium Waterproof Coating – PU-treated to block rainwater effectively.
Lightweight & Comfortable – No heavy feeling, breathable mesh lining.
Reflective Strips – Ensures better visibility in low-light conditions.
Adjustable Fit – Features customizable straps for a secure and comfortable fit.
Complete Set – Includes both a raincoat and waterproof pants for full-body coverage.
Unisex Design – Suitable for both men and women.
Versatile Use – Perfect for motorcycle riding, cycling, hiking, and outdoor sports.
Easy Maintenance – Can be cleaned effortlessly with a facial tissue or a quick wipe.
Free Storage Bag – Compact and easy to carry when not in use.
Enhanced safety features with reflective elements for night riding.
Designed for riders, adventurers, and daily commuters.
Genuine & Official Product
